lines.zh: 我扛着货箱，走得慢一点。
lines.en: I carry a crate of goods, so I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 摊位要挪到光下面，才有人来。
lines.en: The stall must move into the light for customers.

lines.zh: 我数着台阶走，别摔了货。
lines.en: I count the steps so I do not drop the goods.

lines.zh: 这一趟走完，我就该补货了。
lines.en: After this trip I will need to restock.

lines.zh: 靴子磨破了，路却还长。
lines.en: My boots are worn through and the road is long.

lines.zh: 我挑平坦的地方落脚。
lines.en: I choose flat ground for each step.

lines.zh: 货担压在肩上，骨头在响。
lines.en: The yoke presses my shoulder and my bones creak.

lines.zh: 我绕开泥地，箱子会进水。
lines.en: I skirt the mud; water would ruin the crate.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，走夜路确实少。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts is thin for walking at night.

lines.zh: 这条路我熟，闭眼也能挑担走。
lines.en: I know this road; I could haul a load blind.

lines.zh: 前面有村子的话，我能歇脚。
lines.en: If there is a village ahead, I can rest.

lines.zh: 我把最贵的货放在最底下。
lines.en: I keep the costliest goods at the bottom.

lines.zh: 这一路我在心里算利润。
lines.en: I tally my profit in my head along the way.

lines.zh: 担子换肩，我继续走。
lines.en: I shift the load to my other shoulder and walk on.

lines.zh: 我把货一件件摆整齐。
lines.en: I arrange the goods one by one.

lines.zh: 今天的行情不太好。
lines.en: Today's market is not good.

lines.zh: 我在账本上又划了一道。
lines.en: I make another mark in my ledger.

lines.zh: 没人来的时候，我就数货。
lines.en: When nobody comes, I count my stock.

lines.zh: 三块绿宝石，换这把镐。
lines.en: Three emeralds for this pickaxe.

lines.zh: 风把价牌吹翻了，我扶正。
lines.en: The wind flips my price sign; I set it right.

lines.zh: 我在等补货的那一阵。
lines.en: I am waiting for the restock to come in.

lines.zh: 手指头冻僵了，我搓一搓。
lines.en: My fingers are stiff; I rub them warm.

lines.zh: 摊子摆在这里，安全些。
lines.en: Setting the stall here is safer.

lines.zh: 账上少了三枚绿宝石。
lines.en: My ledger is three emeralds short.

lines.zh: 有个客人昨天说要回来。
lines.en: A customer said yesterday he would return.

lines.zh: 我把破掉的木箱钉好。
lines.en: I nail the broken crate back together.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，该收摊了。
lines.en: The sun has shifted; time to pack up.

lines.zh: 我留了一件货，不卖。
lines.en: I keep one item aside, not for sale.

lines.zh: 客人，看看货再说话。
lines.en: Customer, look at the goods before you talk.

lines.zh: 你手里有钱吗，我先问清楚。
lines.en: Do you have coin? I ask first.

lines.zh: 你的靴子走了很远的路。
lines.en: Your boots have walked a long way.

lines.zh: 我抬头，是在估你的钱包。
lines.en: I look up to estimate your purse.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道像刚下矿。
lines.en: You smell like you just left a mine.

lines.zh: 别挡着摊位，光线不好。
lines.en: Do not block the stall; the light is poor.

lines.zh: 你是来买的，还是来抢的。
lines.en: Are you here to buy, or to rob me?

lines.zh: 我认得你这副打扮，同行少。
lines.en: I know that outfit; few of your kind pass by.

lines.zh: 你要是讲价，我先听。
lines.en: If you want to haggle, I will listen first.

lines.zh: 你眼睛盯着这把剑，我看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes are on this sword; I noticed.

lines.zh: 别急，我一样一样给你看。
lines.en: Take your time; I will show them one by one.

lines.zh: 你站得离货太近了。
lines.en: You are standing too close to the goods.

lines.zh: 我们的规矩是先看后付。
lines.en: Our rule is look first, pay after.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡了我的价牌。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my price sign.

lines.zh: 我放下手里的货，抬头看你。
lines.en: I set down my goods and look up at you.

lines.zh: 你看了半天，倒是指个价啊。
lines.en: You've stared long enough. Name a price.

lines.zh: 别打脸，明天还得开摊。
lines.en: Not my face; I open the stall tomorrow.

lines.zh: 货没坏就好。
lines.en: As long as the goods are fine.

lines.zh: 这一下我得算进成本。
lines.en: I will count this blow as a cost.

lines.zh: 我捂着腰，往箱子后躲。
lines.en: I clutch my ribs and duck behind the crate.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，经不起几下。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts will not take many hits.

lines.zh: 你打坏了我的秤。
lines.en: You broke my scale.

lines.zh: 我喊人，这条路上有守卫。
lines.en: I will shout; there are guards on this road.

lines.zh: 血滴在货单上，糟了。
lines.en: Blood drips on the invoice, which is bad.

lines.zh: 我疼得说不出价。
lines.en: The pain leaves me unable to quote a price.

lines.zh: 这生意我不做了，先跑。
lines.en: I am done with this deal; I run first.

lines.zh: 你手里那件东西，我出高价。
lines.en: That thing in your hand, I will pay well for.

lines.zh: 我闻到附魔的味道了。
lines.en: I can smell enchantment on it.

lines.zh: 你肯卖的话，价钱好说。
lines.en: If you will sell, the price is negotiable.

lines.zh: 这枚矿石，我能翻三倍卖。
lines.en: I can resell this ore at triple.

lines.zh: 我不该这么贪心，可它真好看。
lines.en: I should not be this greedy, but it is lovely.

lines.zh: 让我掂一掂，就掂一下。
lines.en: Let me weigh it, just once in my hand.

lines.zh: 你的货比我的好，这很麻烦。
lines.en: Your goods are better than mine; that is a problem.

lines.zh: 我算过利润，值得冒这个险。
lines.en: I ran the numbers; the risk is worth it.

lines.zh: 别收回去，我加两块绿宝石。
lines.en: Do not put it away; I add two emeralds.

lines.zh: 商人的眼睛，见了货就挪不开。
lines.en: A trader's eyes will not leave good merchandise.

lines.zh: 撞到我，货要掉了。
lines.en: Bumping me will drop the goods.

lines.zh: 我的箱子歪了，扶一下。
lines.en: My crate has tilted; steady it.

lines.zh: 别推，我只有十五颗心。
lines.en: Do not shove; I have only fifteen hearts.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我丢了半块面包。
lines.en: That bump cost me half a loaf.

lines.zh: 摊位晃了，价牌全倒了。
lines.en: The stall shook and every price sign fell.

lines.zh: 我退到箱子后面，这样安全。
lines.en: I retreat behind the crates, which is safer.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的账页了，抬脚。
lines.en: You stepped on my ledger page; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁赔。
lines.en: We collided; who pays for this?

lines.zh: 我的手肘磕到木箱角，很疼。
lines.en: My elbow hits a crate corner and it hurts.

lines.zh: 让一让，我搬着东西呢。
lines.en: Make way; I am carrying things.

lines.zh: 两个商人搭伙，本钱能翻倍。
lines.en: Two traders together can double the capital.

lines.zh: 我们分工，你看货我收钱。
lines.en: We split the work: you watch goods, I take coin.

lines.zh: 账本上添了第二个名字。
lines.en: A second name is added to the ledger.

lines.zh: 你算得比我准，我服气。
lines.en: You count better than I do; I concede.

lines.zh: 冬天一起守摊，没那么冷。
lines.en: Sharing a stall in winter is less cold.

lines.zh: 我们把货并成一摊卖。
lines.en: We merge our goods into one stall.

lines.zh: 夜里轮流睡，货不会丢。
lines.en: We take turns sleeping so nothing is stolen.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，价牌都在晃。
lines.en: When you laugh, the price signs wobble.

lines.zh: 两个摊子挨着，客人不用跑远。
lines.en: Two stalls side by side save customers a walk.

lines.zh: 靠墙那个位置，我留给你。
lines.en: That spot against the wall, I saved it for you.

lines.zh: 地上掉着块铁锭，我收了。
lines.en: An iron ingot lay on the ground; I took it.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西也算货。
lines.en: What I find counts as stock too.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时先护住货担。
lines.en: When I bend down, I guard the load first.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币是谁掉的。
lines.en: Whose coin is this on the ground?

lines.zh: 我把它擦干净再摆上摊。
lines.en: I wipe it clean and put it on the stall.

lines.zh: 白捡的东西，利润最高。
lines.en: Found goods give the best margin.

lines.zh: 我拾起一根断箭，还能卖。
lines.en: I pick up a broken arrow; it still sells.

lines.zh: 包里塞满了，装不下。
lines.en: My bag is full; there is no room.

lines.zh: 按斤称，这堆能换半箱货。
lines.en: By weight, this pile trades for half a crate.

lines.zh: 这东西不值钱，但我捡了。
lines.en: It is worth little, but I picked it up.

lines.zh: 客人来了，我先迎上去。
lines.en: A customer is here; I go to meet them.

lines.zh: 你在我摊位前停住了。
lines.en: You stopped in front of my stall.

lines.zh: 我抬手招呼，笑得体面。
lines.en: I raise a hand and smile politely.

lines.zh: 这个客人看起来有钱。
lines.en: This one looks like they have money.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，好做生意。
lines.en: I have your face noted, for business.

lines.zh: 有人朝货箱伸手，我盯住了。
lines.en: Someone reached for a crate; I am watching.

lines.zh: 你不是来买的，我看得出。
lines.en: You are not here to buy; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我把最贵的货往里挪了挪。
lines.en: I slide the priciest goods further in.

lines.zh: 来了就别空手走。
lines.en: Now that you are here, do not leave empty-handed.

lines.zh: 我的目光跟着你的手。
lines.en: My eyes follow your hands.

lines.zh: 我数着你掏出来的每一枚。
lines.en: I count every coin you pull out.

lines.zh: 你摸口袋了，是要付钱吗。
lines.en: You reached for a pocket; are you paying?

lines.zh: 我算着你还差几块。
lines.en: I am counting how many you are short.

lines.zh: 你的同伴在门口望风。
lines.en: Your companion is watching the door.

lines.zh: 我把钱袋挪到身前。
lines.en: I move my coin pouch in front of me.

lines.zh: 别以为我没看见那只手。
lines.en: Do not think I missed that hand.

lines.zh: 我一直在注意货架的缺口。
lines.en: I keep watching the gap in the shelf.

lines.zh: 你往左挪，我就往左看。
lines.en: You move left, my eyes move left.

lines.zh: 价钱谈不拢，就到此为止。
lines.en: If we cannot agree on price, we are done.

lines.zh: 我把秤摆正，等你自己说。
lines.en: I set the scale straight and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 我抄起秤杆打过去。
lines.en: I swing the scale beam at you.

lines.zh: 商人也有一双手。
lines.en: A trader has hands too.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但够你退。
lines.en: It is not heavy, but it will push you back.

lines.zh: 你砸我摊子，我跟你拼。
lines.en: You wreck my stall; I fight back.

lines.zh: 我打得歪，你别笑。
lines.en: I swing badly, so do not laugh.

lines.zh: 秤砣比拳头硬。
lines.en: A scale weight is harder than a fist.

lines.zh: 我护着货，反手一推。
lines.en: Guarding my goods, I shove backhand.

lines.zh: 十五颗心也敢还手。
lines.en: Even with fifteen hearts, I hit back.

lines.zh: 打完这架，货全乱了。
lines.en: After this fight, everything is in disarray.

lines.zh: 我只想把你赶出摊位。
lines.en: I only want you out of my stall.

lines.zh: 我把摊子支在这条路边。
lines.en: I set up my stall beside this road.

lines.zh: 落地第一件事，是摆货。
lines.en: The first thing on arrival is laying out goods.

lines.zh: 新的地方，得重新定价。
lines.en: A new place means new prices.

lines.zh: 我看了看四周，没什么客人。
lines.en: I look around; not many customers.

lines.zh: 我带来半箱货，剩下的路上丢了。
lines.en: I brought half a crate; the rest was lost.

lines.zh: 这里风大，价牌得压石头。
lines.en: Windy here; the signs need stones.

lines.zh: 我的账本第一页还是空的。
lines.en: The first page of my ledger is still blank.

lines.zh: 我从很远的路过来，脚还疼。
lines.en: I came a long way and my feet still hurt.

lines.zh: 三块木板一支，摊子就成了。
lines.en: Three planks and the stall is up.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看天，怕要下雨。
lines.en: I glance at the sky; rain may come.

lines.zh: 火碰到货箱，我扑上去拍。
lines.en: Fire touches the crate; I lunge to beat it out.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，货散了一地。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and goods scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 水漫过货担，我的账本湿了。
lines.en: Water rises over the load; my ledger is soaked.

lines.zh: 爆炸把摊位掀了，货全没了。
lines.en: The blast flips my stall and the goods are gone.

lines.zh: 箭钉进货箱，离我的头一拳。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the crate, a fist from my head.

lines.zh: 魔法打中我，价牌全焦了。
lines.en: Magic hits me and every price sign is scorched.

lines.zh: 我饿着肚子守摊，手在抖。
lines.en: I guard the stall hungry, hands shaking.

lines.zh: 雷打在摊子旁，我抱头蹲下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes by the stall; I crouch and cover my head.

lines.zh: 虚空吞了半个摊位，我抓住桌腿。
lines.en: The void swallows half the stall; I grab the table leg.
